BILL OF SALE

KNOW ALL PERSONS BY THESE PRESENTS, that Halloran Precision Castings, LLC, an Ohio limited liability company ("Seller"), for and in consideration of Four Hundred Eighty Thousand Dollars ($480,000), the receipt and sufficiency of which is hereby acknowledged, does hereby sell, assign, transfer, convey, and deliver to Ridgeline Industrial Partners LLC, a Delaware limited liability company ("Buyer"), all of Seller's right, title, and interest in and to the personal property described on Schedule 1 attached hereto and made a part hereof (the "Assets").

1. Conveyance.

Seller conveys the Assets to Buyer free and clear of all liens, security interests, and encumbrances, other than the Permitted Liens listed on Schedule 2.

2. Warranty of Title.

Seller warrants that it is the lawful owner of the Assets, that it has good right and full authority to sell and transfer them, and that it will warrant and defend title to the Assets against the lawful claims of all persons claiming by, through, or under Seller.

3. Condition of the Assets.

EXCEPT FOR THE WARRANTY OF TITLE IN SECTION 2, THE ASSETS ARE SOLD "AS IS, WHERE IS, AND WITH ALL FAULTS", AND SELLER MAKES NO WARRANTY, EXPRESS OR IMPLIED, AS TO CONDITION, MERCHANTABILITY, OR FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE.

4. Taxes.

Buyer shall pay all sales, use, and transfer taxes arising from the sale of the Assets, and shall indemnify Seller against any such tax assessed against Seller.

5. Further Assurances.

Seller shall execute and deliver such further instruments of conveyance as Buyer may reasonably request to vest title to the Assets in Buyer.

6. Governing Law.

This Bill of Sale is governed by the laws of the State of Ohio.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, Seller has executed this Bill of Sale as of October 20, 2026.

HALLORAN PRECISION CASTINGS, LLC

By: /s/ Dermot Halloran
Name: Dermot Halloran
Title: Managing Member
